memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Chronic, symptoms of bloating and diarrhoea 3-4 days/week, weight 58 kg, waist 82 cm (above female cut‑off 80 cm).
  - Plan: Start mebeverine 135 mg BD (1-0-1, before food), ispaghula husk 5 g OD (1-0-0, after food), loperamide 2 mg SOS as needed. Advise small frequent meals, avoid spicy/fried foods, increase soluble fibre. Review in 3 months.
- Diet advice
  - Breakfast: Idli with coconut chutney, avoid chutney with heavy oil.
  - Lunch: Rice with dal and steamed vegetables, limit ghee.
  - Dinner: Light khichdi, early dinner by 7 pm.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
mebeverine 135 mg BD (1-0-1, before food)
ispaghula husk 5 g OD (1-0-0, after food)
loperamide 2 mg SOS

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
CBC: Hb 12.4 g/dl (12-16), WBC 6.2 x10^9/L (4-10), Plt 210 x10^9/L (150-400).
Stool routine: Ova and cyst negative, pus cells 0-1/hpf.
tTG-IgA: <4 U/ml (negative <7).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been taking the medicines as prescribed. Bloating is better but I still get loose stools after eating out. No abdominal pain.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Improved bloating, occasional diarrhoea 1-2 days/week, weight 57.5 kg, waist 81 cm.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD. Reduce loperamide to SOS only if >3 loose stools/day. Reinforce low‑FODMAP diet, avoid caffeine. Review in 3 months.
- Diet advice
  - Breakfast: Poha with peanuts, limit oil.
  - Lunch: Chapati with vegetable curry, use minimal oil.
  - Dinner: Curd rice, early by 6:30 pm.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-10-05 at 10:30 AM with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Stable, weight 57 kg, waist 80 cm (at cut‑off).
  - Plan: Continue current regimen. Add probiotic sachet OD after breakfast. Reinforce hydration. Review in 3 months.
- Diet advice
  - Breakfast: Upma with vegetables, probiotic after.
  - Lunch: Rice with sambar and steamed veg, limit oil.
  - Dinner: Vegetable dalia, early.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
mebeverine 135 mg BD (1-0-1, before food)
ispaghula husk 5 g OD (1-0-0, after food)
loperamide 2 mg SOS
Probiotic sachet 1 g OD (after breakfast)

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Abdominal ultrasound: Liver normal size, no focal lesion. Gallbladder wall thickness 2 mm (normal). No biliary dilatation. Kidneys unremarkable.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Increased diarrhoea 4 days/week, weight 56 kg, waist 79 cm.
  - Plan: Stop loperamide (ineffective). Start rifaximin 400 mg BD for 2 weeks. Continue mebeverine and ispaghula. Review after course.
- Diet advice
  - Breakfast: Dosa with minimal oil, chutney on side.
  - Lunch: Khichdi with curd.
  - Dinner: Light soup and toast, early.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to Gastroenterology for evaluation of refractory IBS‑diarrhoea, consider colonic transit study and possible bile acid malabsorption testing.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Gastroenterology review: Colonoscopy normal. SeHCAT test abnormal suggestive of bile acid malabsorption. Advised colesevelam 625 mg OD with dinner. Continue current IBS meds.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Irritable bowel syndrome
  - Status: Improved after colesevelam, diarrhoea 1-2 days/week, weight 56.5 kg, waist 80 cm.
  - Plan: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, colesevelam 625 mg OD with dinner. Stop rifaximin (completed). Review in 3 months.
- Diet advice
  - Breakfast: Idli with sambar, minimal oil.
  - Lunch: Rice with rasam and steamed veg.
  - Dinner: Chapati with vegetable curry, early.
